title: Strings seen more than once
prompt:
Write `Repeated(in []string) []string` that returns each string appearing more than once, listed once, in order of first appearance. Return an empty slice, not nil, when there are none.

`[a bb bb b a a]` → `[a bb]`
hint: Count in a map, then walk the input again, so the output order doesn't depend on map order.
